global_invariants: Campaign, Scene and Session remain distinct governed aggregates and lifecycles.
Reusable Definitions remain owned by their source domains; PPIA-08 stores Campaign-local composition, placement, visibility and permitted overrides only.
Uploaded map assets are versioned separately from grid calibration and calibration never destructively rewrites image bytes.
Square and gridless are the required initial coordinate modes; PPIA-08 does not invent a universal distance-per-square.
Grid calibration translation is distinct from camera pan and zoom view state.
Launch snapshots pin exact Scene, map asset, calibration, placement and visibility-policy versions.
Authorization and filtering occur before hidden map or Scene existence, counts, labels, search, layers, errors, exports, diagnostics, notifications or AI context.
Every visual or map projection has a semantic nonvisual equivalent.
Authoritative mutations require expected_version plus operation_id and ambiguous outcomes require status/current-version lookup before retry.
Dungeon geometry never infers collision, cover, line of sight, movement legality, damage, lighting or balance.
No contract activates application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, testers, paid services or production credentials.

projection_groups.title: Encounter, objective, trigger and event links
Preparation, launch snapshot and Session binding

global_mutation_protocol: authorize current subject, role and delegation before protected reference resolution
revalidate aggregate, source-reference, map, calibration and placement versions
on ambiguous response query operation status and current version before retry
compatible duplicate returns prior result or status while conflicting operation-ID reuse fails safely
emit attributable durable event or receipt only after accepted atomic mutation
